name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.32.0

🎨 State color catches up — “Refresh from issues” pulled a state's color only together with a change of the state itself; a project that colored its State field values after sprint composition was built kept gray chips and Gantt bars forever. Color is now compared by value and pulled on any difference — with no phantom “changes” reported when nothing differs.

🌐 Reports re-render on language switch — switching the app language now rebuilds report labels from the dictionary and re-renders open report contours from already-loaded data, without re-running the report.

✍️ Last hardcoded strings localized — eight user-facing strings lived outside the i18n dictionary: the widget-registration banner, the “(h)” unit in XLSX export headers, calendar arrow labels for screen readers, the zombie-value hint in sprint/release selectors, and the Gantt fallback error text. All are now translated into 15 locales.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
